database_summary: Small sales/order/product schema (SQLite) modeled around AdventureWorks-like tables. Contains product catalog (product, productcategory, productsubcategory, productdescription, productmodelproductdescriptionculture, productreview), sales orders (salesorderheader, salesorderdetail), sales people/territories/quotas (salesperson, salesterritory, SalesPersonQuotaHistory) and currency/country mappings (currencyrate, countryregioncurrency). Mix of descriptive/master tables (dimensions), transactional detail (salesorderdetail & header), and time-versioned quota/currency rate history. Many-to-one relationships exist from details to headers and products; joins can multiply rows when joining header->detail->productdescription due to productdescription culture mapping.

accepted.name: product_master
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productid,
  NAME,
  productnumber,
  makeflag,
  finishedgoodsflag,
  color,
  safetystocklevel,
  reorderpoint,
  standardcost,
  listprice,
  size,
  sizeunitmeasurecode,
  weightunitmeasurecode,
  weight,
  daystomanufacture,
  productline,
  class,
  style,
  productsubcategoryid,
  productmodelid,
  sellstartdate,
  sellenddate,
  discontinueddate,
  rowguid,
  modifieddate
FROM product
accepted.description: Normalized product master row per productid. Exposes product attributes and price/cost measures in a single row, with canonical column names preserved. Use when joining products to sales, aggregating by product, or filtering active products. | Use for: list products with price/cost attributes; filter active/inactive products by sellstartdate/sellenddate/discontinueddate; join product attributes to sales lines or reviews

accepted.name: product_with_category
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.productid,
  p.NAME,
  p.productnumber,
  p.productsubcategoryid,
  productsubcategory.productcategoryid AS productcategoryid,
  productsubcategory.name AS productsubcategory_name,
  productcategory.name AS productcategory_name,
  p.standardcost,
  p.listprice,
  p.rowguid,
  p.modifieddate
FROM product p
LEFT JOIN productsubcategory ON p.productsubcategoryid = productsubcategory.productsubcategoryid
LEFT JOIN productcategory ON productsubcategory.productcategoryid = productcategory.productcategoryid
accepted.description: Denormalized product rows joined to their subcategory and category names. Use when reporting or aggregating by category/subcategory alongside product measures. | Use for: aggregate sales by product category or subcategory; list products with their category names; filter products in specific categories

accepted.name: sales_order_line_facts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productid,
  SUM(orderqty) AS total_orderqty,
  SUM((unitprice * orderqty) * (1.0 - IFNULL(unitpricediscount,0.0))) AS total_revenue,
  AVG(unitprice) AS avg_unitprice,
  COUNT(*) AS orderline_count
FROM salesorderdetail
GROUP BY productid
accepted.description: Aggregated salesorderdetail measures at the productid level: total quantity, total revenue (net of unitpricediscount), average unit price, and count of order lines. Useful for product-level sales summaries and trend comparisons. | Use for: top selling products by quantity or revenue; compute revenue per product for P&L analysis; join product-level sales to category/product master

accepted.name: orders_with_lines
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.salesorderid,
  d.salesorderdetailid,
  d.carriertrackingnumber,
  d.orderqty,
  d.productid,
  d.specialofferid,
  d.unitprice,
  d.unitpricediscount,
  d.rowguid AS salesorderdetail_rowguid,
  d.modifieddate AS salesorderdetail_modifieddate,
  h.revisionnumber,
  h.orderdate,
  h.duedate,
  h.shipdate,
  h.STATUS,
  h.onlineorderflag,
  h.purchaseordernumber,
  h.accountnumber,
  h.customerid,
  h.salespersonid,
  h.territoryid AS salesorder_territoryid,
  h.billtoaddressid,
  h.shiptoaddressid,
  h.shipmethodid,
  h.creditcardid,
  h.subtotal AS order_subtotal,
  h.taxamt AS order_taxamt,
  h.freight AS order_freight,
  h.totaldue AS order_totaldue,
  h.rowguid AS salesorder_rowguid,
  h.modifieddate AS salesorder_modifieddate
FROM salesorderdetail d
LEFT JOIN salesorderheader h ON d.salesorderid = h.salesorderid
accepted.description: Denormalized sales order lines joined to their order header. One row per salesorderdetail (sales order line) including header-level attributes like orderdate, customerid, salespersonid and monetary totals for the order. Use for line-level analysis with order context. | Use for: line-level sales with order metadata; order lifecycle and shipping timeliness; compute per-order or per-line KPIs

accepted.name: salesperson_quota_history_latest
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  BusinessEntityID,
  QuotaDate,
  SalesQuota,
  rowguid,
  ModifiedDate,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BusinessEntityID ORDER BY QuotaDate DESC, ModifiedDate DESC) AS quota_row_rank
FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
accepted.description: Latest quota row per salesperson (BusinessEntityID) from SalesPersonQuotaHistory using quota date ordering. Exposes the most recent SalesQuota and ModifiedDate. Use when needing the current quota for each salesperson. | Use for: current quota per salesperson; trend of quotas per salesperson (by removing rank filter); join latest quota to salesperson master

accepted.name: salesperson_master
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  businessentityid,
  territoryid,
  salesquota,
  bonus,
  commissionpct,
  salesytd,
  saleslastyear,
  rowguid,
  modifieddate
FROM salesperson
accepted.description: One row per salesperson/businessentityid including territory, quota and sales YTD measures. Use to join to orders or territory summaries. | Use for: join salesperson attributes to orders or quota history; compute commission-based payouts or rankings; territory-level aggregation of salesperson metrics

accepted.name: territory_sales_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  territoryid,
  COUNT(DISTINCT salesorderid) AS order_count,
  SUM(subtotal) AS sum_subtotal,
  SUM(taxamt) AS sum_taxamt,
  SUM(freight) AS sum_freight,
  SUM(totaldue) AS sum_totaldue
FROM salesorderheader
GROUP BY territoryid
accepted.description: Aggregated sales metrics by territoryid from orders: number of orders, total order subtotal, total tax, total freight, total revenue (totaldue). Useful for territory performance comparisons and trend analysis when joined to salesterritory. | Use for: territory revenue ranking; compare territory performance year-over-year if joined to dates; join territory-level totals to salesterritory master

accepted.name: product_reviews_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productid,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count,
  AVG(rating) AS avg_rating,
  MAX(reviewdate) AS last_reviewdate,
  MAX(reviewdate) FILTER (WHERE reviewdate IS NOT NULL) AS last_reviewdate_nonnull
FROM productreview
GROUP BY productid
accepted.description: Summary of product reviews per productid: average rating, review count, most recent review date and last reviewer. Useful for product quality and feedback analysis. | Use for: list products by average rating or review count; identify recently reviewed products; join review summary to product master for quality metrics

accepted.name: productmodel_description_culture
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  productmodelid,
  productdescriptionid,
  cultureid,
  modifieddate
FROM productmodelproductdescriptionculture
accepted.description: Mapping rows between productmodel and productdescription with culture, useful to surface localized descriptions. One row per (productmodelid, productdescriptionid, cultureid). | Use for: retrieve product descriptions in a given culture; join product models to textual descriptions (localization)
